Naqra product showcase — asset credits

3D model: “Monitor pc” by Marco De Simone (marcodesimone888).
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/monitor-pc-57ad4ef2e8294ed884be642a0ef42df6
Author: https://sketchfab.com/marcodesimone888
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Changes: the monitor's screen texture is replaced at runtime with captures from
the Naqra app, with an unlit screen material and adjusted camera field of view.
The model is embedded through the official Sketchfab Viewer API; no model files
are extracted from the viewer.

Screenshots: captured from the actual Naqra Windows application using its isolated
acceptance profile. Counts and preferences shown are demonstration data.

Quran text visible in app screenshots: Tanzil Quran Text.
